3258-7417-7438.description:
If Sanar isn't prepared, activate Skycoach Waypoint's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, causing Sanar to become prepared.

Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration. If Sanar is prepared to start, you can save {3} the first iteration.

Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3129-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3129-4660-5676.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.

Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.

Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.

Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.

When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
